R-1: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, and the next one rises grey on the slope ahead. Raidho is the road made this way, each stone handing you to the one you can already see. Behind you, Thor, the last one still stands in the heather. Each one sees the next.
R-2: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, the wind cold against your face. Across the brown heather the next one shows grey against the sky, Thor, and beyond it another, smaller still. Raidho is a road kept by sight, each stone within view of the last. No stone stands alone.
R-3: You stand on the open heath beside a cairn, and another rises grey across the moss. Raidho is a road held together by sight, each stone passing you to the one ahead. Only the next one shows, Thor. Behind you, the last cairn stands small in the wind where you left it.
C-1: You stand beside a cairn on the open heath, its stones cold under your palm. Raidho makes a road of bare ground, one stone seen from the last. Wind runs through the heather, Thor, past stones set there by other hands. The next cairn stands grey and plain against the sky, well within sight.
C-2: You stand at a cairn on the open heath, the next one grey in the wind ahead. Raidho is a road held by sight, one stone found from the last. From this stone, Thor, the far edge of the heath stays hidden behind the rise. The next cairn stands clear above the moving heather.
C-3: You stand at a cairn on the open heath, the next one small and grey on the rise ahead. Raidho is a road kept by sight, each stone leading to the next. Thor, the wind runs low across the heather between them. Behind you, the last cairn still stands where it was built.
